claims.text: The Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship is aimed at young people aged 18-24.
The scholarship is part of an initiative to develop young talent.
The scholarship aims to help young people establish themselves in the industry.
The scholarship will use the Nuffield Scholar network to link successful applicants directly to farmers.
The 2026 Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship will run a dairy and a regenerative agriculture study tour.
The study tours are open to applicants from the UK.
Six scholarships were awarded for the 2026 program: 3 dairy and 3 regenerative agriculture.
The 30-day study programme will take place in June/July 2026.
The programme aims to give young people the opportunity to develop their understanding of the industry.
The programme aims to help young people build networks and future opportunities.
The scholarship is fully funded and includes all travel and subsistence.
The scholarship includes attendance at the Nuffield Conference.
The scholarship includes Nuffield Farming Associate membership.
Applications for the 2027 Next-Gen Scholarship will open in November 2026.
The deadline for applications for the 2027 Next-Gen Scholarship is January 31, 2027.
The 2026 Dairy Next-Gen Scholarships are in partnership with The Trehane Trust.
In 2026, three dairy and three regenerative agriculture scholarships were awarded.
In 2027, three dairy and three pig scholarships are planned to be awarded.
The scholarships will be rolled out across various Nuffield Farming study groups.
The scholarship is worth £6,000.
The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000 to cover replacement labour costs.
The 2026 Next-Gen Scholarship recipients will have the opportunity to share their experiences at the 2026 Nuffield Farming Conference.
